activities.title: Cook one dish together from scratch
activities.detail: Split the duties, argue gently about the salt, and eat it straight from the pan.

activities.title: Rebuild your first date-night dish
activities.detail: Same order, same playlist, same seat. Tell the story of how it started.

activities.title: Blind taste: pick three dishes unseen
activities.detail: One of you orders for both. No peeking, no swapping, no complaining.

activities.title: Picnic basket, floor cushions, one blanket
activities.detail: Turn off the overhead lights. Use the dimmer. This is the whole evening.

activities.title: Cook for someone nearby and deliver it
activities.detail: Pick a neighbour, a night-shift worker, or the person a stray cat belongs to.

activities.title: Breakfast in bed, served in silence
activities.detail: One tray, two spoons, no phones. Read the news out loud to each other instead.

activities.title: Sunset walk with nowhere to be
activities.detail: Find the highest spot on your street, bring something warm, and watch the colours change.

activities.title: Night walk with one hour of no talking
activities.detail: Silence is the plan. When the hour ends, each of you says the first thing that comes to mind.

activities.title: Full-day outing with one rule: no phones
activities.detail: Photos only in each other's eyes. Everything else you have to remember.

activities.title: Market trip, one ingredient each
activities.detail: You must both pick something you have never cooked before. Cook it later that night.

activities.title: Drive to the sea and say it by the water
activities.detail: Whatever you have been meaning to say for months, the ocean does not judge.

activities.title: Photo hunt: five poses somewhere that feels like ours alone
activities.detail: Pick five shots you have never done together. Strangers are allowed to laugh.

activities.title: Build a blanket fort and stay in it all evening
activities.detail: Chairs, clothes pegs, fairy lights, one blanket you refuse to share at first.

activities.title: Re-enact the day you met, scene by scene
activities.detail: You each play a part. Improvise every line. It does not have to end well.

activities.title: Slow dance playlist, no talking allowed
activities.detail: Pick twelve songs. Dance through all of them in the same room. Change the last one if you like.

activities.title: Question jar: write, fold, pick at random
activities.detail: Write down things you have never asked. No question is too small, too big or too awkward.

activities.title: Cooking-show night with a foreign recipe
activities.detail: Pick a country at random. Cook something that country is actually famous for. Serve it proudly.

activities.title: Theme night: one colour, one room, one mood
activities.detail: Red, blue, gold or deep green. Dress for it, light for it, talk for it.

activities.title: Museum for two, one room each
activities.detail: Look at different things, then meet up and explain what you saw to each other.

activities.title: Live music you have never heard before
activities.detail: Small room, cheap tickets, no talking during the set. Talk afterwards.

activities.title: Poetry night: read something you wrote to each other
activities.detail: Write a few lines this morning, hide them, and read them out tonight.

activities.title: Cookery class side by side, one basket each
activities.detail: Learn something neither of you can cook. Stay for the wine afterwards.

activities.title: Bookshop date: each picks a book for the other
activities.detail: Buy it without saying anything. Swap at home and read the first page together.

activities.title: Talk about your dreams, one question each
activities.detail: No advice, no fixing. Only ask, then listen properly for five minutes.

activities.title: One-night escape, twenty minutes away
activities.detail: Check into a hotel for one night even if you live ten minutes away.

activities.title: Train to a town with a nice name
activities.detail: Pick the destination by its name alone. Walk around, eat something local, come back.

activities.title: Staycation: one hotel, one day, zero plans
activities.detail: Book the room, then do whatever the day suggests. No schedule allowed.

activities.title: Drive to the coast with no destination
activities.detail: Take the road that looks nicest. Stop when one of you says stop.

activities.title: New neighbourhood, one address each
activities.detail: Each of you picks a café you have never been to. Meet halfway after one hour.

activities.title: Surprise the other with a whole day out
activities.detail: Plan it secretly. The only rule: no clue until the moment you meet.

activities.title: One unhurried hour, no screens
activities.detail: Phones in another room. Everything else is up to the two of you.

activities.title: Ten good things from this week
activities.detail: Each of you names ten. No repeats allowed, and small things count.

activities.title: One compliment each, specific and true
activities.detail: No 'you are beautiful'. Something you actually noticed this week.

activities.title: Slow shower, one turn each
activities.detail: One of you washes, the other rests. Then swap without arguing.

activities.title: Read one page of a book to each other
activities.detail: Take turns reading aloud. Stop whenever you want and talk about it instead.

activities.title: One rule: the winner gets the evening
activities.detail: Play a quick game. The winner plans the entire evening without asking.
